/* v1.3.18 live match clock + match timestamps */
.match-timebar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:10px 0 14px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.34);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16)}.match-timebar>div{display:grid;gap:2px}.match-timebar span{font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em;opacity:.72}.match-timebar b{font-size:13px}.match-running{text-align:right}.match-running b{font-size:22px;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:.02em}.result-time-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:7px 10px 2px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}.result-time-meta span+span:before{content:'•';margin-right:8px}.result-time-meta strong{margin-left:auto;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--text);background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 8px}@media(max-width:420px){.result-time-meta strong{width:100%;margin-left:0;text-align:center}}
